First release of **UniSense**, a UniFi OS-inspired theme for the OPNsense web GUI.

### Install

On the firewall, as root:

```sh
fetch -o /tmp/unisense-install.sh https://github.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/releases/latest/download/install.sh && sh /tmp/unisense-install.sh
```

Then choose **System → Settings → General → Theme → unisense** and save.

### Highlights

- Dark navigation rail, card layout, divider-only tables, rounded controls
- Light, dark and system modes plus six accent colours, from the top bar — no reload
- Dashboard widgets restyled; gauges and the CPU graph follow the accent colour
- MVC pages, data grids, dialogs, classic PHP pages, date picker and the sign-in page
- Collapsed icon rail with fly-outs, phone drawer and tablet layouts
- No external requests; CSS and one small script only, no core files changed

Tested against OPNsense 25.7, 26.1 and 26.7 GUI markup.
